_note: The metro to Yunhai opens only after the town is finished (src/core/unlock.js). `townQuests` are the missions in quests.json that count; the offline Roots steps (meeting Uncle Zhou, the three Qinghe photos, the practice) are added by the rule. A listed mission that is not in quests.json yet (my-camera, until W4-camera adds it) is skipped. home-noodles is left out because only Yunhai's noodle cook teaches the recipe, and reopening the fruit stand because it needs the cloud. Once every step is done, Auntie Lin (`linLesson`) gives Grandpa's card (`card`, a catalog item) and a new album page (`photo`, a Roots memory); the station attendant's chat at the concourse service counter (`checkLesson`) then activates the card. Only journeys from `station` (a metro.json station) wait for this; the card machines (fittings with action metro:machine) always let you top up, and the far end always lets you ride home, so a save that has not unlocked is never stranded in Yunhai. `locked` is what the attendant says at the gates before that, `hints` what townsfolk now and then say in the square while the metro is shut, `questLocked` the note on the metro mission and `linCalls` the notice when Lin is waiting. Clips are unlock-<key>; the listening node reuses the metro's own announcement clip.

questLocked.zh: 完成青禾的任务后开放
questLocked.pinyin: Wánchéng Qīnghé de rènwu hòu kāifàng
questLocked.en: Opens after you finish Qinghe's tasks

linCalls.en: Auntie Lin is looking for you!

locked.zh: 去云海要先多学一点中文。
locked.pinyin: Qù Yúnhǎi yào xiān duō xué yìdiǎn Zhōngwén.
locked.en: Before Yunhai, learn a bit more Chinese.
locked.speaker: attendant

locked.zh: 先把青禾的任务做完，再来找我吧！
locked.pinyin: Xiān bǎ Qīnghé de rènwu zuòwán, zài lái zhǎo wǒ ba!
locked.en: Finish Qinghe's tasks first, then come and find me!
locked.speaker: attendant

hints.pinyin: Yúnhǎi hěn dà, yě hěn rènao!
hints.speaker: friend-a

hints.zh: 等你中文更好了，一定要去云海看看。
hints.pinyin: Děng nǐ Zhōngwén gèng hǎo le, yídìng yào qù Yúnhǎi kànkan.
hints.en: When your Chinese is better, you must go and see Yunhai.
hints.speaker: friend-b

hints.zh: 坐地铁去云海，很快就到。
hints.pinyin: Zuò dìtiě qù Yúnhǎi, hěn kuài jiù dào.
hints.en: By metro you're in Yunhai in no time.
hints.speaker: friend-a

photoNote.en: The sea breeze in Yunhai feels wonderful.
photoNote.speaker: narrator

nodes.speaker: lin
nodes.zh: 你来青禾以后，中文进步了很多！
nodes.pinyin: Nǐ lái Qīnghé yǐhòu, Zhōngwén jìnbù le hěn duō!
nodes.en: Your Chinese has come a long way since you came to Qinghe!

nodes.speaker: lin
nodes.zh: 这是你爷爷的交通卡。他以前常常坐地铁去云海。
nodes.pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ yéye de jiāotōngkǎ. Tā yǐqián chángcháng zuò dìtiě qù Yúnhǎi.
nodes.en: This is your grandpa's transit card. He often took the metro to Yunhai.

nodes.speaker: lin
nodes.zh: 去地铁站的服务中心，请他们帮你开通吧。
nodes.pinyin: Qù dìtiězhàn de fúwù zhōngxīn, qǐng tāmen bāng nǐ kāitōng ba.
nodes.en: Go to the station's service centre and ask them to activate it.

nodes.speaker: attendant
nodes.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Zhè zhāng kǎ shì nǐ de ma?

prompt.pinyin: Shuō zhè shì nǐ yéye de kǎ.

nodes.speaker: attendant
nodes.pinyin: Dàole Yúnhǎi, nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr?
nodes.en: Once you're in Yunhai, where would you like to go?

prompt.pinyin: Shuō yí ge nǐ xiǎng qù de dìfang.
prompt.en: Name a place you'd like to go.

nodes.speaker: attendant
nodes.zh: 刚才广播说下一站是哪儿？
nodes.pinyin: Gāngcái guǎngbō shuō xià yí zhàn shì nǎr?
nodes.en: Where did the announcement say the next stop was?

nodes.speaker: attendant
nodes.zh: 很好！你的中文没问题。卡开通了，祝你玩得开心！
nodes.pinyin: Hěn hǎo! Nǐ de Zhōngwén méi wèntí. Kǎ kāitōng le, zhù nǐ wán de kāixīn!
nodes.en: Great, your Chinese is fine. Your card is active, have fun!
